extraction.Name: David Guerue
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I first mortgaged it and then sold it
extraction.Occupation/Income: I farm and work at odd jobs
extraction.NOTES: Did not make application for patent; received patent in Rosebud from the Farmer, does not remember exact date or signing a receipt; got $1400 in all, $800 on the mortgage and $600 additional at the time of sale; no debts considered in the sale except the mortgage; not satisfied with the sale; wishes the patent had not been issued; has 4 children living and 3 died; subscribed and sworn before Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, March 25, 1929, commission expires 4-28-32
